title: Christmas Bundle
author: OK-Design
fullDescription:
Christmas Bundle – Total 352 files for only $12 save $111!

This set includes vector illustrations in JPEG, PNG, PDF, SVG, DXF formats:
1) 1 Santa Claus New Year Greeting card on a green background;
2) 1 Santa Claus Christmas Greeting card on a blue background;
3) 2 Christmas Greeting card of Santa Claus in a medical mask and Santa Claus smiles;
4) 2 New Year Greeting card with a planet in a gift box;
5) Christmas quarantine deer in medical mask – design for Cricut;
6) 2021 – design for Cricut;
7) Girl in Santa Hat – Sublimation Design:
8) 88 Christmas Gift Tags (44 Blue and 44 Red Tags);
9) 55 elements of New Year’s clipart – suitable for sublimation;
10) 25 faces of snowmen – suitable for sublimation;
11) 25 stickers with snowmen;
12) 8 stickers with New Year’s deer;
13) Elf Adoption certificates in 2 versions – portrait and landscape orientation;
14) Elf Welcome and goodbye Letters Letter Size (8.5 x 11 inches);
15) Santa Claus Christmas Elf comes Letter Letter Size (8.5 x 11 inches);
16) Santa Claus welcome letter Letter size (8.5 x 11 inches);
17) Elf Calendar SVG. The Kind and Naughty Elf Letter size (8.5 x 11 inches);
18) Christmas Advent Cards with Activities Letter Size 8.5 x 11 inches;
19) Cute elf in SVG format. The size is 3600 pixels on the Russian side. Suitable for sublimation printing. Available in 7 formats;
20) Christmas Santa SVG. Santa Claus SVG;
21) Christmas deer antlers – design for the pillow. Suitable for Cricut.

Total 352 files for only $12 save $111!
